# Owen Ford

## Overview

- **Age:** 30 to 35 years old  <sub>[v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Leslie Moore  <sub>[v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 c38 P28](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ontario (or Toronto)  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Newspaper man and author/writer  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 c24 P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027)</sub>

## Appearance

Owen Ford is a tall, broad-shouldered man with a handsome, clean-shaven chin and thick brown hair. He has large, brilliant dark-gray eyes and a very attractive smile. His features and dark eyes give him a striking resemblance to his grandmother, Persis Selwyn.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c24 P20](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0020)_

## Personality

Owen is an agreeable, articulate, and imaginative individual who possesses a deep appreciation for beauty and storytelling. While naturally amiable and witty in conversation, he carries an underlying seriousness and depth of feeling. He is fiercely dedicated to his creative pursuits and exhibits great warmth and empathy toward others.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002)_

## History

Owen Ford grew up knowing the lore of Four Winds Harbor from his mother, Alice Selwyn. After recovering from typhoid fever, he visited Four Winds in the summer to recuperate and search for inspiration for a novel. Staying at the Moore homestead as a boarder, he met Leslie Moore and quickly fell deeply in love with her, though he kept his feelings hidden due to her tragic marriage. During his stay, he struck up a close friendship with Captain Jim and collaborated with him to turn Captain Jim's 'life-book' into a manuscript. After concluding his work, he confessed his love for Leslie to Anne Blythe before departing. Later, upon the discovery that Leslie's husband was actually his cousin George Moore and that Leslie was free, Owen returned to Four Winds, declared his love, and became engaged to Leslie, planning to purchase the old house at Four Winds to serve as their summer home.

_Sources: [v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c25 P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 c25 P11](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0011), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c31 P27](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0027), [v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_
